name: 담화 표지 분석
description: 분석합니다 the usage 패턴 of 담화 표지 (connectives, transitions) to differentiate AI 생성 from 인간이 작성한 text.
useCase: 응집성 담화 접속사의 과다 또는 과소 사용을 통한 AI 텍스트 감지
mechanism: 식별합니다 and quantifies 담화 표지 (e.g., 'however', 'therefore', 'furthermore', 'in addition') and their positional 분포 내의 texts. AI 생성 text typically exhibits a narrower set of 담화 표지 with more formulaic placement 패턴. The method constructs a discourse marker profile and compares it against human reference 분포s using Jensen-Shannon divergence.
source: Kumarage et al. (2023) - Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines, arXiv
algorithm: Discourse Marker Extraction + Positional Analysis + Distribution Comparison
parameters: Marker lexicon: 150+ markers, Position tracking: sentence-initial/medial/final, Frequency normalization: per-sentence, Comparison: JSD metric
strengths:
